text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O takes 1st,
it's T.M. Opera O!!
She gloriously seizes the crown of Derby Umamusume!!
(UWAAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahahaha!!
Spandendo! Spandendo!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Nevertheless—
the one who plays the victor's aria is none other than myself!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...However, ah, I know it all too well.
You haven't stepped down from the stage just yet.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that right?
O comrades who weave this era alongside me——!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haaah--

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Wah... wait, Ayabe-san...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, no! —Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I guess this is your first time?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...You're looking right at someone,
looking so genuinely frustrated for their sake."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Ah-ah, what a shame, though!
Or rather, I'm frustrated too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Man, I really wanted to be the one to make her make that face!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Top Road-san...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. ...Now I'm certain.
Ayabe-san will definitely become even stronger
by the time the Kikuka Sho comes around.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"So, I have no intention of slacking off either!
I'll reforge myself at the summer training camp.
Going all out, focusing on stamina!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
And so—
Let's race again, Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Next time, at the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: At the Kikuka Sho... once more.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Haa, ngh...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (My legs are wobbling. ...I'm exhausted.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (And yet, my body feels strangely light. Just floating, like a balloon with its string cut—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (I feel like I might just start running again.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Next is the final race
of the Classic Triple Crown line... the Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Next time, too... a race like today's—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.
